_comment: FLUX.2 [Klein] 9B - Text to Image, CHECKPOINT loader variant.
Export (API) format, ready for a bitGen Studio image style
(Settings -> Image, Rendered by ComfyUI).
IDENTICAL to img_flux2_klein_9b_t2i.json except for node 70, which is a
CheckpointLoaderSimple instead of a UNETLoader. Use this one when your
model file lives in a folder ComfyUI treats as CHECKPOINTS - most often a
Forge/A1111 'Stable-diffusion' folder mapped in extra_model_paths.yaml.
UNETLoader only lists files under its diffusion_models search paths, so a
model filed as a checkpoint simply does not appear in its dropdown,
whatever the file actually contains.
ONLY THE MODEL OUTPUT IS USED. Outputs 1 (CLIP) and 2 (VAE) are left
unconnected on purpose: a FLUX.2 model file usually carries the
transformer weights ALONE, so those outputs are empty and connecting one
would fail at load. The text encoder still comes from node 71 and the VAE
from node 72, exactly as in the UNETLoader version.
MODELS (into ComfyUI's OWN folders, not bitGen Studio's):
models/checkpoints/<your flux2 klein model>.safetensors
models/text_encoders/qwen_3_8b_fp8mixed.safetensors
models/vae/flux2-vae.safetensors
Distilled: cfg 1.0, ~4 steps. THE ALTERNATIVE to this file is to leave the
model where it is and hard-link it into diffusion_models with
Settings -> Image -> the 'make this loadable' action (POST
/api/comfymodels/install); that keeps the UNETLoader template. Both are
valid - this one changes the workflow, that one changes the folder.
THE NEGATIVE PROMPT IS NOT A PROMPT HERE. Node 76 (ConditioningZeroOut)
takes the POSITIVE conditioning and zeroes it - that is what a distilled
model uses in place of a negative. bitGen Studio detects this and refuses to
write a negative prompt into it.
